cohort: The study included 1,694,043 mother-term infant pairs from Taiwan.
finding: Cesarean delivery, maternal antibiotic use, specific maternal infections, maternal diabetes mellitus, premature rupture of membranes, and lower birth weight are associated with an increased risk of early-onset sepsis in term neonates.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a significant risk factor for early-onset sepsis with an adjusted OR of 1.45 (95% CI, 1.28-1.64).
